environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running in namespace 'microservices' on EKS 1.27. Pod runs as container image python:3.11-slim with PyJWT 2.6.0. The RSA public key is mounted from a Kubernetes Secret at /etc/keys/public.pem via a standard volume mount. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced (privileged namespace). The container runs as root. Network policy allows all ingress. Service exposed via NodePort.
